Sample Program

A sample photo caption.

The Sample Program is a reimbursement grant program that provides up to $1,000 for North Dakota nonprofit art organizations and individual artists to learn.

Application Deadline FY27

  • Six weeks prior to the start date of the proposed activity, 11:59 pm CST
  • Applications for FY27 will close on May 31, 2027, 11:59 pm CST.

Grant Award Range

  • Maximum award request: May not exceed $1,000 or 80% of the total project cash expenses, whichever is less.
  • 20% match required

For Assistance

Contact the Council.
